no_adcom_quote.quote: Since this is the fourth application for a product for the prevention of severe neutropenia and no unexpected clinical efficacy or safety issues were observed, no advisory committee meeting was held.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for GRANIX (tbo-filgrastim, BLA125294). The review documents state this was the fourth application for a product for the prevention of severe neutropenia and that no unexpected clinical efficacy or safety issues were observed, so an Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee meeting was not needed. The Medical Review (L962) explicitly states 'There was not an Advisory Committee Meeting for this application,' and the Cross-Discipline Team Leader review records the Advisory Committee Meeting section as 'Not applicable.'
